pricing.billingNote: Paywall required after a tiny free preview limit.
pricing.freeTierNote: Allows streaming a few sample clips before blocking playback with a membership wall.

specNotes.free_no_paywall: Charges $4.95/mo or $29.95/yr for unimproved 24–64 kbps public-domain trader MP3s.

primary_source_verification.summary: Copies raw collector dates with zero newspaper or archival verification.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Displays unverified legacy trader dates with no source attribution."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: No episode-level cast or character credits.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Zero per-episode cast, writer, or character role metadata."

master_provenance.summary: Low-bitrate 24–64 kbps MP3s scraped from public collector archives.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Re-hosts low-bitrate collector MP3s with no restoration or lineage documentation."

serial_continuity.summary: Basic table listing with frequent gaps in serial arcs.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Flat episode list with no serial arc tracking."

open_api_export.summary: Paywalled HTML player with zero API or RSS support.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Authenticated session gate blocks direct access, RSS feeds, and APIs."

ad_free_playback.summary: Blocks free listening with a commercial paywall over public-domain recordings.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "Requires paid subscription after initial sample streams."

dedup_integrity.summary: Retains duplicate and mislabeled files from early-2000s trader discs.

gotchas.title: Rent-Seeking Paywall on Unimproved Public Domain Files
gotchas.detail: Charges users to stream low-bitrate MP3s that were digitized by unpaid community volunteers and are freely available elsewhere.

gotchas.title: Zero Archival Value-Add
gotchas.detail: Adds no newspaper date verification, no audio remastering, no cast credits, and no `.vtt` transcripts.
